_comment: IronRelay client config — copy to ironrelay.json and fill in your values.
_comment_script_keys: Add one entry per Apps Script deployment. The client auto-builds the full URL from the ID. Use multiple IDs (even across Google accounts) for round-robin failover.
_comment_relay_url: Alternative to script_keys: point directly at your CF Worker.
_comment_tunnel_key: Generate with: ironrelay -keygen   Must match the PSK on the server / CF Worker.
_comment_fronting: Domain fronting: dial google_host IP, present sni in TLS ClientHello.
_comment_socks_auth: Optional SOCKS5 username/password (RFC 1929). Both must be set or both omitted.
_comment_tuning: coalesce_step_ms: 0 = off; 20-40 ms reduces Apps Script calls under burst traffic. idle_slots_per_bucket: 1 (safe default); raise to 2 if each Google account has 2+ deployments. poll_ms: default 50.
